name: Dr. Ramesh Kaki
role: Machine Learning Engineer · PhD in Machine Vision
text:
Aryan worked with me on machine vision and robotics projects, and he was a dependable person to have on the team. He approached problems patiently and stayed with them until they were solved, which matters in vision work where the first approach rarely survives real conditions. He also coordinated the team well, kept the work moving, and took up responsibility willingly whenever it was needed. I am glad to recommend Aryan and I am sure he will do well wherever he goes.
All the best Aryan

name: Prof. Sandip Deshmukh
role: Founder, Sasha Innoworks · Professor, BITS Pilani
text:
I have known Aryan Rai since his undergraduate years at BITS Pilani, where I had the opportunity to teach and mentor him, and later work with him at Sasha Innoworks. Aryan has consistently impressed me with his sincerity, dedication, curiosity, and ability to take initiative. He was among the most committed students in my course, demonstrating exceptional discipline and a genuine interest in learning beyond the classroom. His involvement in laboratory projects, research, and product development reflected his ability to connect technical knowledge with practical problem-solving.
At Sasha Innoworks, Aryan demonstrated strong ownership and leadership by contributing to the development of our Autonomous Mobile Robotics and robotic arm initiatives, while leading and mentoring a team of interns under the guidance of Dr. Ramesh Kaki. I particularly appreciate his ability to approach challenges from multiple perspectives, bring structure to complex tasks, coordinate people effectively, and translate ideas into practical outcomes.
He is a quick learner, analytical thinker, and dependable team player with a good balance of technical understanding, business awareness, and execution skills. I am confident that these qualities will help him excel in diverse professional environments. I wish him great success in all his future endeavours.
